corrections: Replaced generic triangular fronds with separate broad leathery leaflet surfaces on retained pinnate rachises and a low caudex.
Added partial outer-margin serration and longitudinal vein cues with subdued matte pigment.
Varied frond elevations and replaced the open fan-like cone with a closed selected compact cone study; changed old-leaf-base cues and reproductive framing.
findings.residual: Leaflets still appear too smooth, dark and regularly paired; fine farina/hairs, serrations, venation and optical response are incomplete. Caudex/leaf-base and cone surfaces remain artificial at close range; the cone is partly obscured by petioles. The selected cone is not a complete sex/stage series or measured plant, and red-seed exposure/development is not animated.
